body:
Found during a harness audit, and confirmed by asking Playwright rather than by
reading the config.

    npx playwright test --list  ->  459 tests in 66 files
    ls frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts   ->  67 files

The missing one is `subpath.spec.ts`.

MECHANISM, all OBSERVED in frontend/playwright.config.ts:
  desktop  testIgnore: [/subpath\.spec\.ts/, /mobile\.spec\.ts/]      (line 50)
  mobile   testIgnore: [/subpath\.spec\.ts/, /default-library-view/]  (line 70)
  ipad     testMatch:  /book-card-actions\.spec\.ts/                  (line 76)
  subpath  exists ONLY when process.env.E2E_SUBPATH_URL is set        (line 88)

and no workflow sets E2E_SUBPATH_URL — .github/workflows/tests.yml sets
E2E_BASE_URL only. So the project that would match the spec is never
constructed, and the spec is ignored by every project that is.

WHY IT MATTERS: this is the suite that guards serving under a reverse-proxy
prefix, i.e. the documented white-page / reader-404 class. A regression there
ships through a fully green e2e gate with zero sub-path assertions executed.

NOT a config bug in itself — the spec genuinely needs the nginx rig
(cwn-nginx-571, http://localhost:8087) that ordinary CI does not stand up. The
defect is that the exclusion was INVISIBLE: nothing said "this suite does not
guard CI", so the file's existence read as coverage.

Half-fixed already: tests/unit/test_e2e_specs_are_reachable.py now asks
Playwright what it would run and fails if any spec is matched by no project,
with subpath recorded in INFRASTRUCTURE_GATED and the reason attached. A NEW
never-run spec now fails immediately. This one stays a real gap.

TO CLOSE IT, one of:
  a) stand the nginx rig up in the E2E job and set E2E_SUBPATH_URL — highest
     fidelity, costs a container in CI;
  b) run the suite against the existing app served under a prefix by the test
     server, without nginx — cheaper, tests less of the real path;
  c) accept it as a local-only suite and say so in the runbook, so nobody reads
     a green e2e gate as covering sub-path serving.
title: The reverse-proxy sub-path e2e suite has never run in CI
